learning_outcomes.text: After successful completion of the module, students understand and can apply the basic principles of kinematics and kinetics.
They are able to perform motion analyses of point masses and rigid bodies.
Motion equations for various mechanical systems can be derived.
Students can apply the concepts of work, energy, momentum, and angular momentum in dynamic systems.
They master solving the model equations as well as evaluating and checking the plausibility of the results.

syllabus_topics: Kinematics of a point mass: Motion in non-accelerated reference frames, velocity and acceleration, rectilinear motion, motion in accelerated reference frames, evaluation in different coordinate systems

Kinetics of a point mass: Newton's fundamental laws, work-energy theorem, energy conservation law, impulse and impulse conservation law, collision processes, angular momentum and angular momentum conservation law, extension to point mass systems
Kinematics of a rigid body: Translation and rotation, instantaneous center of rotation, relative motion in rotating reference frames
Kinetics of a rigid body: Mass moments of inertia, equations of motion for rigid bodies, work-energy theorem, energy conservation law, impulse and angular momentum
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module exam. The grade is weighted according to the ECTS credit points.
